address: Rue de la Colline 58, Transinne, 6890, Belgium
bio: A slightly smoky aroma tickles your nostrils as soon as you reach the carpark of this former farmstead, which tastefully sports untreated materials to create a warm vibe. Loélia Gachadoat and Vadim Poncelet, steadfast champions of barbecue cooking, demonstrate their combined talents, mingling rustic flavours with a creative festival of occasionally surprising nuances. The symbiosis between these two chefs signs the characterful cuisine....
